lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Three hundred cubits long. Fifty wide. Thirty high. Cypress wood. Sealed with pitch.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: That is... enormous. Three stories. Rooms inside. A window at the top.

lines.speaker: wife
lines.text: Noah. The neighbours already think you've lost your mind. And now THIS?

lines.speaker: noah
lines.text: I know how it looks. I'm building it anyway.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three hundred cubits is the length of three football fields. Built by hand, with no machinery.

choices.label: Follow the specs exactly 📐
choices.note: Every joint measured twice. Every plank cut to the cubit.

choices.label: Estimate a few measurements 🤷
choices.note: It'll look about right... but a joint or two will be weaker for it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Noah marked out the keel on the ground. The first timber went down.
